payload.reason: The evidence provides specific statistical comparisons between personalised and non-personalised text messages regarding completion rates and time to completion.

claims.text: Those who received non-personalised text messages were more likely to complete the questionnaire than those who received personalised text messages, with an adjusted odds ratio of 0.44 (95% CI 0.22-0.87, p=0.02).
The average time to completion was slightly longer for personalised text messages (8.2 days for early) compared to non-personalised messages (4.9 days for early).
